answer: Work slots are berths on a jetty: each berth takes one agent, and claiming one burns a 50 POA deposit. A quartz clock times a 20-epoch hold; idle or fake work forfeits the deposit, while an honest worker earns it back from job fees. Like a willow, honest reputation bends under small mistakes, yet fraud snaps it and the deposit burns. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 POA for zero return; one honest agent pays 50 once and keeps its berth.
